conventions: Paths are relative to the repo root. Packages run in waves by their files: P241, P243 and P247 side by side; then P242, P244 and P245; then P246. P242 and P244 build on P241. Keep the catalogs' marks: “…” and ’ in English; «…» in Spanish and Catalan; ’ in Catalan; ICU plurals and selects as written. Owner decisions bind every package (.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md), above all the newest, 2026-10-22, «Reminder plans»: one task, one plan, and reminders are notifications about the task, never copies of it; the plan counts back from the deadline, else the task's own day; «Hasta la fecha límite» with Suave, Normal and Intenso for everyone, worked out on the phone, with its preview (the plan in words, dots to the day, the next reminder); a rhythm said while dictating is honoured for free accounts too (it's the same AI call); «A tu manera», typed or said, only with Pro, and free accounts see it with a Pro badge that opens the Pro screen; the offer after saving a task whose day is far; after the day, one last notice, then silence. Also D2 of 2026-10-13 (the one-time reminder question) and D1 of 2026-10-20 (UX-1601: ask only when a reminder can still ring here).

The contract binds the app: Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md. Where a brief changes something the contract quotes (the task's line, the count, the offer, «A tu manera»'s helper, the notices), the brief says so; contract updates are notes for the main session, and no package changes Backend/. This plan's decisions are open and no package pre-empts them: D1 (a plan replaces a timed task's single reminder, so its own day rings at the plan's time), D2 (how far back a strength starts), D3 (a reminder said for a task with no day), D4 (the row's name «Hasta la fecha límite»), D5 (stopping the offer after repeated «Ahora no»), D6 (plans on shared tasks in the reminder sheet), D7 (RevenueCat's paywall).

The speed bar holds: a plain one-task dictation stays Añadir tarea → speak → Listo → one confirming tap, and looks and saves as today. The test 'a plain single-task dictation looks and saves exactly as before, with no new tap' (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:1019) keeps passing. Judge every screen as a first-time, non-technical user would, in Spanish, often at large text: the owner's father.
Subtract first. No new settings, screens, tabs or concepts beyond what a brief names, and new strings only where a brief gives the copy.
Out of scope: Backend/ (the contract included), and another session's uncommitted work: Backend/, App/pubspec.yaml, App/scripts/, App/config/; also .claude/ux-web/. Don't edit, format or stage them.

Tests: the implementer keeps the whole suite passing, runs only the tests of the files it touched, and updates only the tests its change rightly breaks (briefs name those they know); ux-tester writes the acceptance tests and reads copy through the generated AppLocalizations. Harnesses: App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart (`_App.open(tester, tasks, pro:, language:, textScale:, size:, reminders:, captures:)` :828, with `app.detail(id)`, `app.task(id)`, `app.api` (the «A tu manera» endpoint, `answer`), `app.speech` (a fake recognizer), `app.reminders` (MemoryReminderStore, `offered`), `app.notifier`, `app.navigator`; helpers `openSheet`, `tapVisible`, `inSheet`, `chipText`; fixtures `now`, `friday13`, `ownersPlan`, `presentation()`), App/test/reminder_plans_test.dart (the plan logic and words), App/test/reminder_plan_engine_test.dart and App/test/reminder_engine_test.dart (the engine with a fake `_Driver`), App/test/support/ (reminder_fixtures.dart, capture_fixtures.dart with `openCaptureResult` and `saveCapture`, design_fixtures.dart, never_syncing_tasks.dart), and the preview suite's App/test/ux_previews/ (reminders_previews.dart, capture_previews.dart, settings_previews.dart, support/).

packages.title: The plan's line names reminders and the strength, gives the next one's time, and promises only what will come
brief: Context: run 2026-10-22-changes reviewed reminder plans (aa2f53a). One line describes a task's plan on every surface, all through `reminderPlanText` (App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:79-92) → `planLine` (App/lib/l10n/reminder_plan_words.dart:66-92): the task's reminder chip (ReminderChip, :462-573, on the task detail), the value of the «Recordatorio» row of ReminderControl (:575-718: the form's Más detalles and, after P242, the capture card), and the form's closed-details line (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:942-951, which you don't change: it calls reminderPlanText). This package changes what that line says, when it says «próximo», and the count under the sheet's dots. P242 builds the capture card's row on it; P244 reuses the lowercase rhythm you add.

UX-1806 (S2; merged with UX-1902 from review B). The line never says it's about reminders, or which strength. A strength reads «Cada vez más a menudo hasta el jue 12» for Suave, Normal and Intenso alike, so switching Normal → Intenso changes nothing on the task (renders reminders/task-line.strength.*); a plan of one's own reads «Cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana», the app's own words for a repeat (the repeat chip's «Cada {interval} días»). Every other chip state starts with the word («Recordatorio: 09:00», «Sin recordatorio · Activar»), and TalkBack reads «Cada vez más a menudo hasta el jue 12 · próximo: mañana», button (AUDIT, reminders/task-line · strength). Fix: start the line with the noun and name the strength. A strength: ES «Recordatorios suaves | normales | intensos hasta el jue 12», EN “Gentle | Normal | Intense reminders until Thu 12”, CA «Recordatoris suaus | normals | intensos fins al dj. 12», with the today and tomorrow forms reminderPlanGrowing already has (ES «… hasta hoy», «… hasta mañana»; EN “… until today”, “… until tomorrow”; CA «… fins avui», «… fins demà»). A plan of one's own: ES «Recordatorios: {rhythm}», EN “Reminders: {rhythm}”, CA «Recordatoris: {rhythm}», the rhythm lowercase after the colon: «Recordatorios: cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana». New keys, for example `reminderPlanStrengthLine` (a `strength` select gentle / normal / other, plus the `when` select and `date` placeholder as in reminderPlanGrowing) and `reminderPlanOwnLine`. Give `planRhythm` (:28-51) an option to return the rhythm uncapitalised; its default output stays capitalised (the sheet's preview, P243 and the tests use it as it is).

Settled between the reports: the same line goes on every surface, the titled «Recordatorio» rows included (the form's, and the card's after P242), so one plan reads the same everywhere and a change of strength shows wherever the plan shows. Review B asked to leave the noun out of titled rows; that would leave the three strengths reading alike there. The strength row's own subtitle in the sheet («Cada vez más a menudo hasta el jue 12», reminderPlanGrowing at App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart:417-424) stays as it is. One exception, from review B: where the line follows a person's name (`_Reason.text` → `reminderForPerson`, reminder_control.dart:111-118, used by the chip at :524-535 and the row at :689-699), the value is the bare line, lowercase: «Recordatorio para Ana: cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana · próximo: …» and, for a strength, «Recordatorio para Ana: cada vez más a menudo hasta el jue 12 · próximo: …».

UX-1807 (S2). The line gives the next reminder's day but never its time: «recuérdamelo el día antes a las 8» reads «El día antes · próximo: mié 11», and a plan with no time rings at Settings' time for tasks without a time (9:00) even for a 17:00 appointment, with nothing saying so. Fix: add the time to «próximo», in the app's clock format (pass `context.clockTime` from reminderPlanText, as `planCount` takes `clock`, :96-104). `reminderPlanLine` (app_es.arb:1392, app_ca.arb:1096, app_en.arb:3625) becomes ES `{plan} · próximo: {when, select, today{hoy} tomorrow{mañana} other{{date}}}, {time}`, EN `{plan} · next: {when, select, today{today} tomorrow{tomorrow} other{{date}}}, {time}`, CA `{plan} · proper: {when, select, today{avui} tomorrow{demà} other{{date}}}, {time}`. Example: «Recordatorios: cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana · próximo: sáb 24, 09:00»; with a 12-hour clock, “… · next: Sat 24, 9:00 AM”.

UX-1804 (S3; merged with UX-1903 from review B). «próximo» comes from `ReminderPlans.alerts(...)` with the default `late: true` (reminder_plan_words.dart:84), so it counts the one last notice the day after, and it ignores a completed task. Said on Thu 22 Oct, «Dentista el martes a las 10, recuérdamelo una semana antes» reads «Una semana antes · próximo: mié 28», the day after the appointment, while nothing rings before it. On the task's own day after the plan's time a strength reads «… hasta hoy · próximo: mañana», while the sheet's count says «Ya no quedan avisos» (planCount uses `late: false`, :105). After Completar on the detail (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:487-500) the chip keeps «próximo: mañana», though the engine has cancelled everything. And `_alertPassed` (reminder_control.dart:56-77) never calls a plan passed while that last notice is to come, because ReminderEngine.alertAhead counts it. Fix: (1) «próximo» counts only reminders on or before the anchor's day: take it from `ReminderPlans.taskAlerts(task, dateOnlyTime, now, late: false)` (App/lib/services/reminder_plans.dart:83-100), which also returns nothing for a completed task; (2) a completed task's line is the plan alone, with no «próximo»: «Recordatorios normales hasta el vie 13»; (3) in `_alertPassed`, a plan is passed when that same list is empty (reminders on, task not done): then the chip and the «Recordatorio» row read the existing `noReminderTimePassed` («Sin recordatorio: ya ha pasado la hora del aviso» / “No reminder: the alert time has passed” / «Sense recordatori: l’hora de l’avís ja ha passat») with the off bell, and a tap still opens the sheet to choose another, as for a passed single reminder. Settled between the reports: review B wanted a plan with nothing ahead to read as the plan alone; for a task that isn't done, review A's passed text is used, because a plan line with no «próximo» still reads as a promise when nothing will ring (the dentist case). Don't change `ReminderEngine.alertAhead` (App/lib/services/reminder_engine.dart:235-262): the first reminder question and the engine keep counting the last notice.

UX-1910 (S1). The count runs «el próximo» into the day: «13 avisos · el próximo mañana, 09:00». Write it as the line does. `reminderPlanCount` (app_es.arb:1375, app_ca.arb:1079, app_en.arb:3461) becomes ES `{count, plural, =1{1 aviso: {when, select, today{hoy} tomorrow{mañana} other{{date}}}, {time}} other{{count} avisos · próximo: {when, select, today{hoy} tomorrow{mañana} other{{date}}}, {time}}}`, CA `{count, plural, =1{1 avís: {when, select, today{avui} tomorrow{demà} other{{date}}}, {time}} other{{count} avisos · proper: {when, select, today{avui} tomorrow{demà} other{{date}}}, {time}}}`, EN `{count, plural, =1{1 reminder: {when, select, today{today} tomorrow{tomorrow} other{{date}}}, {time}} other{{count} reminders · next: {when, select, today{today} tomorrow{tomorrow} other{{date}}}, {time}}}`. Dates keep their form («sáb 24»); the one-notice form drops «el».

Don't touch: the sheet's rows and sections (P243, P245), the capture card (P242), the offer (P244), the notices' text (P246), `planNotice` and `planOffer` (reminder_plan_words.dart:116-133), the strength row's subtitle, and ReminderEngine. Update the tests your change breaks: the word tests in App/test/reminder_plans_test.dart («the plan in words», :637-836) and the chip and line expectations in App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart («on the task» :565, «the capture’s card» :630, «at 2× text» :507). Re-render reminders/ (task-line.*, sheet.strength.*, capture-card.plan.*) and keep the descriptions true. Note for the main session: Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md, «The sheet and the task», quotes the old line («Cada 3 días… · próximo: sáb 25», «Cada vez más a menudo hasta el jue 12») and count («N avisos · el próximo sáb 25, 9:00»).
acceptance: Task detail, Spanish, 1×, 360×800, clock Thu 22 Oct 2026 10:00, reminders on and allowed, «Presentar el proyecto» on Fri 13 Nov with Normal: the reminder chip reads «Recordatorios normales hasta el vie 13 · próximo: sáb 24, <9:00 in the app's clock>».

Same task: chip → «Hasta la fecha límite» → «Intenso» → «Listo»: the chip reads «Recordatorios intensos hasta el vie 13 · próximo: …»; with «Suave», «Recordatorios suaves hasta el vie 13 · próximo: …».

Same task with `ownersPlan`: the chip reads «Recordatorios: cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana · próximo: sáb 24, <9:00>»; in English with a 12-hour clock, “Reminders: every 3 days, and daily for the last week · next: Sat 24, 9:00 AM”; in Catalan it starts «Recordatoris: cada 3 dies, i cada dia l’última setmana · proper: ».
The chip's semantics label (AUDIT for reminders/task-line.strength and task-line.own-words) starts with «Recordatorios».
Completar on the task detail of the Normal task: the screen stays open and the chip reads «Recordatorios normales hasta el vie 13», with no «próximo».

Clock Fri 13 Nov 2026 10:00 (the task's own day, after its 9:00 notice), Normal, not done: the chip reads «Sin recordatorio: ya ha pasado la hora del aviso» with the off bell; tapping it opens the reminder sheet, whose count reads «Ya no quedan avisos».

Clock Thu 22 Oct 2026 10:00, a task on Tue 27 Oct at 10:00 with a custom plan whose only phase is 7→7 every 1 (one notice a week before, already past): the chip reads «Sin recordatorio: ya ha pasado la hora del aviso», not «… · próximo: mié 28»; tap → the sheet → «10 minutos antes» → the chip reads «Recordatorio: 10 minutos antes».

A task assigned to another member, Ana (assignment member, her id, assigneeName Ana), with `ownersPlan`: the chip reads «Recordatorio para Ana: cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana · próximo: sáb 24, <9:00>».

The form of the Normal task (edit): with Más detalles open, the «Recordatorio» row's value reads «Recordatorios normales hasta el vie 13 · próximo: sáb 24, <9:00>»; with Más detalles closed, the grey line under the summary reads the same.

The sheet's count for Normal on Fri 13 Nov from Thu 22 Oct 10:00 reads «13 avisos · próximo: sáb 24, <9:00>»; a plan with one notice left reads «1 aviso: <day>, <time>» with no «el»; Catalan «13 avisos · proper: …»; English with a 12-hour clock “13 reminders · next: Sat 24, 9:00 AM”.

At 2× on 360×800, Spanish and Catalan, the chip's line for `ownersPlan` and for Normal wraps with the time visible and no clipped text (renders reminders/task-line.own-words.es.light.2x and task-line.strength.ca.light.2x; AUDIT reports no clipping).

packages.title: The capture card: one «Recordatorio» row for a said reminder, honest about this phone, shown in collapsed rows, and never saved when it can't apply
brief: Context: the capture's result card (App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart) shows a reminder said while dictating in two places and two forms: a plan as a bespoke bell row under the date (:657-667, opening `editTaskReminder`), and minutes said («una hora antes») as grey text in «Más opciones»' subtitle (`optionsSummary`, :492-505); «Más opciones» also holds the card's ReminderControl (:758-786). This package replaces both with one row, the existing ReminderControl. It builds on P241 (the line's words, its «próximo» and the passed state live in reminder_control.dart and reminder_plan_words.dart). A plain dictation must look and save exactly as before.

UX-1805 (S2). From the plan's row, choosing «Elegir hora del aviso», «predeterminado» or «Desactivado» clears the plan (`_chooseReminder`, App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:352-367) and the row vanishes; «1 hora antes» reappears further down as «Más opciones»' subtitle. Changing a said single reminder takes «Más opciones», a scroll, «Recordatorio», then a choice (3 taps and a scroll) against 2 for a plan; with «Más opciones» open and a plan set, the plan shows twice. Fix: one reminder row. Add `_reminderOpen` next to `_notesOpen` (:59-61): true when the draft's task arrives with a reminder set — `reminderPlan != null`, or `reminderMinutes != null` (including -1, «Desactivado» said), or `reminderTime != null` (a resumed draft changed earlier) — and set true by any change made through the row; once true it stays for this card, as the notes field does. While it's true, show the card's existing ReminderControl (the same arguments as :758-786) where the plan row is now (:657-667), above «Más opciones»; remove the bespoke row; remove the reminder entry from `optionsSummary` (:498-504); and don't build the ReminderControl inside «Más opciones» (:758-786) while it shows above, as the card already does for notes and the project. Update `belowNotes` (:524-537), which counts `plan != null`, to count the row instead. The row has the title «Recordatorio», reads whatever is chosen («Recordatorios: cada 3 días… · próximo: …», «1 hora antes», «10 minutos antes · predeterminado», «18:00», «Desactivado»), and opens the same sheet. No new copy. A draft with nothing said keeps the ReminderControl inside «Más opciones» as now. Keep a key on the new row (for example `draft-reminder-<draft id>`) for the tests.

UX-1802 (S3). Neither the card's plan line nor the said «Recordatorio: 1 hora antes» checks whether this phone can ring. With reminders off here (the default until the one-time question) or notifications blocked, the card reads «… · próximo: mañana»; once saved, an account that answered «Ahora no» before, or a phone that blocks notifications, is asked nothing, the plan never rings, and the task's page then reads «Sin recordatorio · Activar». Fix: it comes with the row. ReminderControl already shows the existing «Activar recordatorios» / “Enable reminders” / «Activa els recordatoris» button under the row when this phone won't ring (`_cannotFire` with `planned`, reminder_control.dart:33-50; the button :709-714), running `turnOnReminders` (:175-265). Keep the line's words and add nothing else. Turning reminders on there records that they were asked (`asked: true`), so the one-time question after saving doesn't come for this save.

UX-1809 (S2). In a result of several tasks, a collapsed row (:803-815) shows its title and date line only, so a rhythm said for one task is never seen before «Añadir 2 tareas». Fix: in a collapsed row whose card would show the reminder row (`_reminderOpen`), add one line under the date line (:808), built like `_dateLine(main: false)` (:367-395): the bell at 18 dp, the text in bodyMedium, a chevron, and a tap. Its icon, text and tap are the task's reminder chip's (ReminderChip, reminder_control.dart:462-573): the plan's line («Recordatorios: cada semana · próximo: …», notifications_active_outlined), «Recordatorio: 1 hora antes» (notifications_outlined), «Sin recordatorio · Activar» when this phone won't ring (its tap turns reminders on), or «Sin recordatorio: ya ha pasado la hora del aviso» (notifications_off_outlined for both); otherwise the tap opens the reminder sheet (`editTaskReminder`, :373-403, with `_change`). Take the chip's reading into one helper in reminder_control.dart that ReminderChip and this line both use (for example a function returning the icon, the text and the action for a task), so they can't drift. The line's TalkBack label is its text, as a button. Rows with no reminder said stay as they are.

UX-1811 (S1). Clearing the day («Sin fecha») or adding a repeat on the card makes the plan stop applying, but the task is saved with it (App/lib/services/capture_store.dart:223-237), so giving the task a day later turns it back on unseen. The form drops a plan it can't keep when saving (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:423-431). Fix: in the save loop, after `normalizeResponsibility` (:226-230), save `task.copyWith(reminderPlan: null)` when `!ReminderPlans.plannable(task)`, and store that same task in the draft (`updated.add(...)`, :237). On the card, with the row from UX-1805, clearing the day makes the row read the existing «Añade una fecha para usar un recordatorio» / “Add a date to use a reminder” / «Afegeix una data per utilitzar un recordatori» (ReminderControl's `dateForReminder`, reminder_control.dart:686-688) instead of vanishing.

Don't touch: the date line, the title, the questions, the project and person, the steps; «Más opciones»' other rows; ReminderControl's own behaviour (reminder_control.dart:575-718) beyond the shared chip helper; the reminder sheet (P243, P245); the offer after saving (P244). The plain-dictation test (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:1019) keeps passing and render capture/result.one-task is unchanged (7 tap targets in AUDIT). Update the «the capture’s card» tests (App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:630-685) that find the old row by `draft-reminder-plan-<id>`. Re-render reminders/capture-card.plan (es 1×, 2×; ca 2×) and add `reminders/capture-card.plan-reminders-off` (es 2×: reminders off on this phone, the plan's line and «Activar recordatorios») and `reminders/capture-card.several-plan` (es 1×: three collapsed rows, one with a plan line).

The same with notifications blocked by the phone. With reminders on and allowed, no button.

Render capture/result.several, which has no reminders, is unchanged.

A draft with `ownersPlan` → date line → «Sin fecha»: the row reads «Añade una fecha para usar un recordatorio»; «Añadir al calendario» → the saved task has no reminder plan. A draft with `ownersPlan` given a weekly repeat on the card and saved → the saved task has no reminder plan.
At 2× on 360×800, Spanish and Catalan, the card with `ownersPlan`: the «Recordatorio» row's title and whole line can be scrolled into view with no clipped text (AUDIT).
deviceChecks: Android 13+ (emulator lane or phone), reminders off and never allowed: «Activar recordatorios» on the capture card shows Android's notification dialog over the capture sheet, then the exact-alarms step if Android asks, and the sheet keeps its draft.
TalkBack on a phone: the card's row reads «Recordatorio», then its line; a collapsed row's reminder line reads as a button.

Said aloud on a phone: the owner's sentence («Presentar el proyecto de empresa en tres semanas, recuérdamelo cada 3 días las dos primeras semanas y luego cada día») and «Dentista el 12 de noviembre a las 5, avísame una hora antes» each show one «Recordatorio» row.

packages.title: The reminder sheet: a dictated plan shows as chosen for everyone, the chosen plan opens in view, plans only where they help, and TalkBack hears the rows expand
brief: Context: the reminder sheet (App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart, `_ReminderPlanSheet`) lists the single reminder's rows, then «Hasta la fecha límite» (Suave · Normal · Intenso) and «A tu manera». It opens from the task's reminder chip and, through `editTaskReminder`, from the capture card. Owner decisions (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-22): the strengths for everyone; a rhythm said while dictating honoured for free accounts too (it arrives as a `custom` plan); «A tu manera» typed or said only with Pro, and free accounts see it with a Pro badge that opens the Pro screen. P245 changes «A tu manera»'s listening, reading, kept words and copy in this same file after you: leave `_hear`, `_read`, `_toggleListening`, `dispose` and the ARB copy to it.

UX-1801 (S3; merged with UX-1901 from review B). A free account that dictated a rhythm opens the sheet on «A tu manera» (`_open`, :87-91), but without Pro that row is never selected or ticked (:469), shows the badge and opens the Pro screen (:470-476), and its section isn't built (:478); no single row is ticked while a plan is set (:402-404). So nothing is chosen, the plan's words show nowhere, and the one row that matches asks to pay for what was free (render reminders/sheet.your-way-free shows the badge). Fix: when the task's plan is `custom` (`widget.plan?.isRhythm == false`), draw «A tu manera» as the strength row is drawn, for everyone: selected; ✓ while its section is closed and the expander while open; its rhythm (`planRhythm`) as the subtitle while closed, as the strength row shows reminderPlanGrowing while closed (:417-424); no ProBadge; a tap toggles its section (`_toggle(_Open.custom)`). Without Pro, that section holds the plan's preview (PlanPreview for `widget.plan`) and «Listo» (`_Apply(plan: widget.plan!)`, which keeps the plan and closes), with no text field and no «Dictarlo», since they call the assistant. With Pro the section stays as it is. The badge and the Pro screen stay for a free account whose task has no custom plan. Choosing a strength (and Listo) or a single row still replaces the plan. Settled between the reports: «Listo» is shown (review A) rather than left out (review B), because every open section ends with it and it is the sheet's only visible way out. No new copy.

UX-1810 (S2). The sheet opens with the plan's section open (:87-91) but only `_toggle` scrolls a section into view (:169-187); on a timed task at 2× on 360 dp the six single rows fill the screen, none ticked, and the plan the person came for starts below. Fix: when the sheet opens on a plan, after the first frame bring that plan's row to the top of the sheet: `Scrollable.ensureVisible(<the row>, alignment: 0)` on «Hasta la fecha límite» for a strength and on «A tu manera» for a custom plan, with `duration: Duration.zero` when `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)` is set and 200 ms otherwise (give each row a GlobalKey; keep their ValueKeys). The same opening serves the chip and the capture card.

UX-1904 (S2). Every dated task that doesn't repeat gets the two plan rows, so a task due today, tomorrow or overdue has 2 more rows that give little or nothing: for a task due today after 9:00 the row promises «Cada vez más a menudo hasta hoy» while its preview says «Ya no quedan avisos», and Listo still swaps «10 minutos antes» for one «Era para ayer» tomorrow; an overdue task offers a day already gone. Fix: show the divider (:411), «Hasta la fecha límite» and «A tu manera» (with their sections) only when the anchor (`ReminderPlans.anchor(widget.task)`) is 2 or more days away (`ReminderPlans.daysUntil(anchor, now) >= 2`, with the `now` the sheet already reads from calendarClockProvider) or the task already has a plan, so it can still be changed or removed. Otherwise the sheet is its title and the single rows, the list the chip showed before plans (`_pickFrom`, App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:421-460). Do it inside this sheet; leave reminder_control.dart to P241 and P242. No new copy.

UX-1907 (S2). TalkBack reads «Hasta la fecha límite» and «A tu manera» as plain buttons with no expanded or collapsed state (AUDIT, reminders/sheet · strength), and reads «Hoy» and the day under the dots (PlanPreview, :648-670) as two loose texts between the plan sentence and the count. Fix: wrap each expandable row in `Semantics(expanded: <its section is open>, hint: <open ? MaterialLocalizations.collapsedHint : expandedHint>, onTapHint: <open ? expansionTileExpandedTapHint : expansionTileCollapsedTapHint>)`, as ExpansionTile's header does in this SDK; «A tu manera» with the Pro badge, which opens the Pro screen, gets no expanded state. Put «Hoy» and the day under the dots inside the dots' ExcludeSemantics (:641-646): the count says it in words. Nothing changes on screen.

Don't touch: the single rows' one-tap behaviour, the strengths' chips and preview, the count's wording (P241), the field, «Dictarlo» and their messages (P245), the Pro screen (P247). The existing free test (App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:265-291, a task with no plan) must still find the badge and open the Pro screen. Re-render reminders/sheet.* and add `reminders/sheet.your-way-free-dictated` (es 1×, 2×: a free account, a task with `ownersPlan`, opened from the chip) and `reminders/sheet.tomorrow` (es 1×: a task due tomorrow without a plan, single rows only).
acceptance: Free account, Spanish, 1×, 360×800, clock Thu 22 Oct 2026 10:00, «Presentar el proyecto» on Fri 13 Nov with `ownersPlan`: the chip opens the sheet with «A tu manera» selected and its section open, showing `reminder-plan-preview` («Cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana», the dots, «13 avisos …») and «Listo»; there is no `reminder-plan-words` field, no «Dictarlo» and no ProBadge in that row, and no other row is selected.
Same: «Listo» closes the sheet and the task keeps `ownersPlan`; Back also keeps it; «Hasta la fecha límite» → «Normal» → «Listo» replaces it with Normal.
Same free account, from the capture card (a draft with `ownersPlan`, the reminder row tapped): the same sheet state.
Free account, a task with no plan: «A tu manera» shows the Pro badge and opens the Pro screen.
Pro, the task with `ownersPlan`, its section closed by a tap: «A tu manera» shows ✓ and the subtitle «Cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana».

At 2× on 360×800, Spanish: a task on Fri 13 Nov at 17:00 with `ownersPlan`, opened from the chip: «A tu manera» sits at the top of the sheet's visible area and the preview's first line is on screen, without the test scrolling; with Normal instead, «Hasta la fecha límite» sits at the top and the three strength chips are on screen.

Anchor today, tomorrow and yesterday, no plan: the sheet has no `reminder-plan-until-day` and no `reminder-plan-your-way`, only the title and the single rows. Anchor in 2 days: both rows are there. A task due tomorrow with Normal: both are there, «Hasta la fecha límite» selected.

Semantics: «Hasta la fecha límite» reports expanded false with the collapsed hint, and expanded true after a tap; «A tu manera» likewise for Pro; the strip's «Hoy» and the task's day are not in the semantics tree (AUDIT for reminders/sheet.strength no longer lists them).
deviceChecks: TalkBack on a phone announces «Hasta la fecha límite» and «A tu manera» as collapsed or expanded.

packages.title: The offer after saving: only when nothing was chosen, only for tasks that ring here alone, naming the task and what «Sí» gives, with Deshacer
brief: Context: after saving a task whose anchor is 14 or more days away, with reminders on, `askAboutRemindersAfterSave` (App/lib/widgets/reminder_ask_sheet.dart:41-82) waits for the save message, then `_offer` (:176-253) shows `_PlanOfferSheet` (:255-289): «Faltan 3 semanas: ¿te lo recuerdo hasta entonces?», «Sí» (sets Normal) and «Ahora no», at most once per task. The owner decided the offer (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-22). This package narrows when it comes and says what it does. Don't pre-empt D1 (a plan replacing a timed task's single reminder), D2 (how far back a strength starts), D5 (stopping the offer after repeated «Ahora no») or D6 (plans on shared tasks in the sheet). It builds on P241's lowercase `planRhythm`.

UX-1803 (S3; merged with UX-2006 from review D). «Dentista el 12 de noviembre a las 5, avísame una hora antes» saves with `reminderMinutes: 60` (App/lib/models/capture_session.dart:86-89); after the message the offer asks anyway (`offerable` checks only `reminderMinutes != -1`, App/lib/services/reminder_plans.dart:105-110), and «Sí» sets Normal, which replaces that reminder: nothing at 16:00. A reminder chosen in the form gets the same. And every edit save calls the question (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:563), so fixing one letter of a far task's title brings the offer (the offer's own tests trigger it that way). Fix, both conditions: (1) in `offerable`, the reminder is still the default: `task.reminderMinutes == null && task.reminderTime == null`, which replaces `!= -1`; (2) offer only when the save created the task or moved its anchor's day: give `askAboutRemindersAfterSave` an optional flag (for example `offerPlan`, default true) that skips `_offer` when false; the form's edit save (task_editor.dart:511-563, `before` at :511) passes true only when `ReminderPlans.anchor(before)` and `ReminderPlans.anchor(task)` fall on different days, or `before` had none. Creates (task_editor.dart:638; App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:3310 and :3949) keep the default. The one-time question, with reminders off, is unchanged on every save. No new copy.

UX-1808 (S3; merged with UX-2002 from review D, with its severity). The sheet names no task, no day and no rhythm. After «Comprar pan mañana y presentar el proyecto el 12 de noviembre», Calendar lands on tomorrow with the bread lit (voice_task_screen.dart:3178-3233), so «lo» reads as the bread; at 2× the sheet covers the lit row (render reminders/offer.asked.es.light.2x). «Sí» means 13 notices at 3 weeks and 66 at 6 months, and TalkBack reads «Sí, botón», while the first reminder question says «Sí, recuérdamelo». Fix, keeping the step and its two choices: (1) first line, the task: its title and its anchor joined by « · », with the app's existing labels: «{title} · {taskDayLine}» (App/lib/widgets/task_schedule_label.dart:8; «Análisis de sangre · jue, 12 nov · 8:00» for a timed task), or, when the anchor is a deadline, «{title} · {taskDeadlineLabel}» (App/lib/widgets/task_planning_control.dart:7; «… · Vence jue, 12 nov»); in titleMedium, onSurface, at most 2 lines with an ellipsis. (2) The question names the rhythm, with Normal's words from `planRhythm` (App/lib/l10n/reminder_plan_words.dart:28-51) uncapitalised, for the task's anchor and now: `reminderPlanOfferWeeks` becomes ES `{weeks, plural, =1{Falta 1 semana. ¿Te aviso {rhythm}?} other{Faltan {weeks} semanas. ¿Te aviso {rhythm}?}}`, EN `{weeks, plural, =1{1 week to go. Shall I remind you {rhythm}?} other{{weeks} weeks to go. Shall I remind you {rhythm}?}}`, CA `{weeks, plural, =1{Falta 1 setmana. T’aviso {rhythm}?} other{Falten {weeks} setmanes. T’aviso {rhythm}?}}`; `reminderPlanOfferMonths` becomes ES `{months, plural, =1{Falta 1 mes. ¿Te aviso {rhythm}?} other{Faltan {months} meses. ¿Te aviso {rhythm}?}}`, EN `{months, plural, =1{1 month to go. Shall I remind you {rhythm}?} other{{months} months to go. Shall I remind you {rhythm}?}}`, CA `{months, plural, =1{Falta 1 mes. T’aviso {rhythm}?} other{Falten {months} mesos. T’aviso {rhythm}?}}` (the months forms, in all three languages, are the organizer's, following review D's weeks). `planOffer` (:129-133) takes the rhythm. Example: «Faltan 3 semanas. ¿Te aviso cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana?». (3) The filled button reuses `reminderAskYes` («Sí, recuérdamelo» / “Yes, remind me” / «Sí, recorda-m’ho»), keeping the key `reminder-plan-offer-yes`; remove the then unused `reminderPlanOfferYes` from the three catalogs. (4) TalkBack: one header and live region holding the task line, then the question (merged), as the question alone is now (:266-274). (5) Fit (review D): at 2× on 360×800 and on 320×640, in Spanish and Catalan, the task line, the question and both buttons must be on screen without scrolling; if they aren't at 320×640 with the question in titleLarge, the question uses titleMedium at every size.

UX-2003 (S3). The filter is only `task.isForAccount(me)` (:192-201), and `group` («Todos», the default for a new task in a shared project, App/lib/widgets/task_assignment_picker.dart:13) counts as one's own; «Sí» writes a synced plan, so every member's phone rings about 13 times with nothing saying who set it. The same filter offers a plan for a task in a project this phone has muted, which this phone never rings (UX-1601's rule). Fix: offer only for a task that rings on this phone alone: `TaskDatabase.reminderBlock(task, me, archived:, muted:, role:) == null` (App/lib/services/task_database.dart:405-425), with the project read from `taskListsProvider` as `_reasonFor` does (App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:133-157), and `task.assignment == 'personal'` or (`'member'` with `assigneeId == me`); never `group` or `unassigned`. No new copy. The sheet still lets anyone put a plan on a shared task: that is D6.

UX-2008 (S2). «Listo. Te lo recordaré hasta el vie 13.» (:231-252) has no way back; removing the plan means the task, its reminder line and another choice, a path the newcomer won't find. Fix: add «Deshacer» (`undo`) to that message; its action puts back the task as it was before «Sí» (`current`, :221-230) through `updateTask`, shown at once without waiting for sync (`showLocal()`, App/lib/providers/task_provider.dart:75), as the app's other Deshacer do; on failure show `undoError`. Copy unchanged. The task stays offered: it isn't asked again.

Don't touch: the one-time question (`_ReminderAskSheet`, and `_ask` with reminders off) and its guards (after the save message, never over another screen or tab, once per task per phone), ReminderEngine, the sheet's plan rows. The offer's tests save a title-only edit to trigger it (`saveEdit`, App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:688-700), which no longer offers: make them move the task's day to Fri 13 Nov (or create it), keeping each test's intent, and update the texts they look for (`offer()`, :703-704) and the planOffer tests (App/test/reminder_plans_test.dart:838-846). Re-render reminders/offer.asked (es 1×, 2×; ca 2×) and keep its description true. Note for the main session: Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md, «The offer», quotes the old question and «Sí», and doesn't list the new conditions.
acceptance: Form, a new task «Presentar el proyecto» on Fri 13 Nov (no time), Spanish, 1×, 360×800, clock Thu 22 Oct 2026 10:00, reminders on and allowed: after the save message closes, the offer reads, top to bottom, «Presentar el proyecto · vie, 13 nov», «Faltan 3 semanas. ¿Te aviso cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana?», «Sí, recuérdamelo», «Ahora no».
The offer's semantics: one header node that reads the task line, then the question; the filled button's label is «Sí, recuérdamelo».

«Sí, recuérdamelo» → the task has Normal and the message «Listo. Te lo recordaré hasta el vie 13.» offers «Deshacer»; «Deshacer» → the task has no reminder plan at once, with a sync that never completes, and the engine plans its single reminder again.

No offer for a task 3 weeks away saved with `reminderMinutes: 60`, nor with `reminderTime` set; the task keeps them and has no plan. A dictation «Dentista el 12 de noviembre a las 5, avísame una hora antes» (`reminder_minutes: 60`) saved → no offer.
An edit save of a task 3 weeks away that changes only its title → no offer; an edit save moving a task from tomorrow to Fri 13 Nov → the offer.

A dictation of two tasks, «Comprar pan» tomorrow and «Presentar el proyecto» on Fri 13 Nov, saved: the offer's first line names «Presentar el proyecto», not «Comprar pan». A dictation of one far task still brings the offer (the test at App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:768 passes with the new text).

A task 3 weeks away in a shared project with assignment group («Todos») → no offer; assigned to me (member, my id) → the offer; a personal task in a project muted on this phone → no offer; in an archived project → no offer.
At 2× on 360×800 and on 320×640, Spanish and Catalan: the task line, the question, «Sí, recuérdamelo» and «Ahora no» are all on screen without scrolling.

English: “3 weeks to go. Shall I remind you every 3 days, and daily for the last week?” and “Yes, remind me”; Catalan: «Falten 3 setmanes. T’aviso cada 3 dies, i cada dia l’última setmana?» and «Sí, recorda-m’ho».
`reminderPlanOfferYes` no longer exists in app_en.arb, app_es.arb or app_ca.arb.
deviceChecks: TalkBack on a phone reads the offer's task line, then the question, then «Sí, recuérdamelo».
Two accounts on two phones (the owner): a far task saved as «Todos» in a shared project brings no offer to its creator and no plan notices on the other member's phone.

packages.title: «A tu manera»: stop and Listo stay in view, read words survive closing, an example up front, and Catalan says «termini»
brief: Context: «A tu manera» (Pro) in the reminder sheet (App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart) is a field to type or say a rhythm, read by `POST /api/ai/reminder-plan/` (`_read`, :200-268), with «Dictarlo» / «Dejar de escuchar» (`_toggleListening` :281-312, `_hear` :314-338). P243 changes this file's rows, opening and semantics in the wave before yours: search for the code a line number points at, and keep what it did.

UX-1905 (S2). At 2× on 360 dp the field grows to 4 lines while listening, but nothing reveals it: «Dejar de escuchar» and «Escuchando» fall below the fold (render reminders/sheet.your-way-listening.es.light.2x), leaving only the 30-second cap; after a read, the plan sentence and dots land at the bottom edge and the count and «Listo» below it. The tests hide it: App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:548 and App/test/ux_previews/reminders_previews.dart:163 scroll to «Listo» themselves. Fix: reveal the end of the «A tu manera» section with the same call `_toggle` uses (:169-187), `Scrollable.ensureVisible(section, alignmentPolicy: ScrollPositionAlignmentPolicy.keepVisibleAtEnd)`, after the frame of each update of the field while listening (in `_hear`) and after a read finishes (its preview or its problem shown), with `duration: Duration.zero` when `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)` is set, 200 ms otherwise. No new controls. Remove the test's and the preview's own scrolling to «Listo» after the read.

UX-1906 (S2). `dispose` (:141-150) keeps only words not yet read (`_custom == null`), so typing, seeing the dots, then Back, a swipe or a tap above the sheet drops the words and their plan; reopening shows an empty field, and getting the plan back costs another AI call. Fix: keep the words and the plan read from them, by account and task as `_unsentProvider` does now (:62-64, :93-95), until a choice is applied (a single row, a strength's Listo, or this Listo), whether they were read or not; drop them only when a choice is applied. Reopening shows those words with their preview and «Listo» and sends no request: initialise `_words`, `_custom` and `_readWords` from what was kept (:96-106); kept words win over the current plan's own `said`. A capture's draft, which has no id yet, still keeps nothing.

UX-1908 (S2). The empty field's only help is «Escríbelo o dilo como se lo dirías a alguien.» (`reminderPlanYourWayHint`, app_es.arb:1365); the first example appears only in the failure message (`reminderPlanUnclear`, :1370), and after it «Dictarlo» appends the new words to the misunderstood ones (`_prefix`, :298) and sends both. Fix: (1) the helper becomes an example of a shape the strengths can't give: ES «Por ejemplo: «una semana antes y el día antes a las 8».», EN `For example: “a week before, and the day before at 8”.`, CA «Per exemple: «una setmana abans i el dia abans a les 8».»; (2) `reminderPlanUnclear` becomes ES «No lo he entendido. Prueba a decirlo de otra forma.», EN “I didn’t get that. Try saying it another way.”, CA «No ho he entès. Prova de dir-ho d’una altra manera.»; (3) after an unclear read, «Dictarlo» starts from an empty field: clear the field and `_prefix` when listening starts while the last read was unclear. Typing still edits the words as they are. Note for the main session: the contract quotes the old helper.

UX-1909 (S1). Only here does the Catalan app call the deadline «data límit»; everywhere else it's «Termini» (app_ca.arb:59). Catalan only: `reminderPlanUntilDay` (app_ca.arb:1064) «Fins al termini»; `reminderPlanOffline` (:1075) «Això necessita connexió. «Fins al termini» funciona sense.»; `reminderPlanFailed` (:1076) «Ara no ho he pogut llegir. Torna-ho a provar més tard, o tria «Fins al termini».». If the owner renames the row (D4), Catalan follows that instead.

Don't touch: the rows, the opening scroll, the free account's section and the semantics (P243); the strengths; the request's shape; P241's count. Update the «A tu manera» (:265) and «at 2× text» (:507) tests that read the old copy or scroll for themselves. Re-render reminders/sheet.your-way.* and sheet.your-way-listening.*, and add a 2× listening state with four lines of words in it (es 2×).
acceptance: Pro, Spanish, 2×, 360×800: «A tu manera» → «Dictarlo» → the fake recognizer sends partial words until the field shows 4 lines → «Dejar de escuchar» and «Escuchando» are hit-testable without the test scrolling.

Pro, Spanish and Catalan, 2×, 360×800: type the owner's words and press done → after the answer, `reminder-plan-apply` is hit-testable with no ensureVisible in the test; with animations disabled, the reveal happens without an animation.

Pro: type → read (one request) → Back → reopen the sheet from the chip: the field holds the words, `reminder-plan-preview` and «Listo» show, and the API has received exactly one request in total; then a single row is chosen → reopen → the field is empty.

The empty field's helper reads «Por ejemplo: «una semana antes y el día antes a las 8».» in Spanish, `For example: “a week before, and the day before at 8”.` in English and «Per exemple: «una setmana abans i el dia abans a les 8».» in Catalan.
An unclear answer shows «No lo he entendido. Prueba a decirlo de otra forma.»; then «Dictarlo» with the recognizer saying «cada día» → the field reads exactly «cada día».

Catalan: the sheet's row reads «Fins al termini»; offline: «Això necessita connexió. «Fins al termini» funciona sense.»; a failed read: «Ara no ho he pogut llegir. Torna-ho a provar més tard, o tria «Fins al termini».».
deviceChecks: Real recognizer on a phone at the largest font: a long rhythm said into «A tu manera» keeps «Dejar de escuchar» on screen.

packages.title: Plan notices: the day and time in words, one per task in the shade, no snooze, and the last days always set
brief: Context: each plan day is its own notification (identity `…/plan/<date>`, App/lib/services/reminder_engine.dart:145-150), built by `planReminders` (:160-192) with the body `ReminderCopy.planBody` (App/lib/services/reminder_copy.dart:141-145) → `planNotice` (App/lib/l10n/reminder_plan_words.dart:116-127). Only the next `ReminderPlans.window` (4) are set; a WorkManager job a minute after the earliest sets the next (App/lib/services/notification_service.dart:174-190). Owner decision: after the day, one last notice, then silence; «Era para ayer» and «Venció ayer» are his words. D1 and D2 are open: don't change when notices ring (the plan's time, the all-day time, how far back a strength starts), only what they say, which actions they carry, how they're kept in the shade and how many are set ahead. The preview suite renders no notification: prove this with unit and engine tests.

UX-2005 (S2). The text is only «Faltan 12 días», «Es mañana» or «Es hoy»: no date, no time, and no deadline when the plan counts to one, while the same task's single reminder says «Hoy a las 17:00 · en 10 min» or «Fecha límite: vie, 25 sept a las 17:00» (the b10 standard, UX-409). Fix: build the body from the task (its anchor, whether the anchor has a time, whether it's a deadline) in ReminderCopy, with its formats as `body` does (:102-139: `formatMediumDate` for the date, `formatTimeOfDay` with `use24`, and the `hour` value that gives Spanish and Catalan «a la 1:00» / «a las 17:00»). Bodies, ES · EN · CA: (a) day anchor, 2 or more days ahead: «Faltan 12 días · jue, 12 nov» · “12 days left · Thu, Nov 12” · «Falten 12 dies · dj., 12 de nov.»; with a time, the date is followed by «, 17:00» («Faltan 12 días · jue, 12 nov, 17:00»). (b) Day anchor tomorrow or today, with a time: «Es mañana a las 17:00» / «Es hoy a las 17:00» · “It’s tomorrow at 5:00 PM” / “It’s today at 5:00 PM” · «És demà a les 17:00» / «És avui a les 17:00»; without a time, «Es mañana» / «Es hoy» as now. (c) Deadline anchor, 2 or more days ahead: «Fecha límite: jue, 12 nov · faltan 12 días» · “Deadline: Thu, Nov 12 · 12 days left” · «Termini: dj., 12 de nov. · falten 12 dies»; with a time, «Fecha límite: jue, 12 nov, 17:00 · faltan 12 días». (d) Deadline anchor tomorrow or today: with a time, the existing `notificationDeadlineAt` («Fecha límite: mañana a las 17:00», «Fecha límite: hoy a las 17:00»); without a time, today the existing `notificationDeadlineToday` («Fecha límite: hoy»), tomorrow a new key: «Fecha límite: mañana» · “Deadline: tomorrow” · «Termini: demà». (e) The day after: unchanged («Era para ayer», «Venció ayer»). Keys: `reminderPlanNoticeDays` takes a `date` (ES `{days, plural, =1{Falta 1 día · {date}} other{Faltan {days} días · {date}}}`, EN `{days, plural, =1{1 day left · {date}} other{{days} days left · {date}}}`, CA `{days, plural, =1{Falta 1 dia · {date}} other{Falten {days} dies · {date}}}`); new, for example, `reminderPlanNoticeDeadlineDays` (ES `{days, plural, =1{Fecha límite: {date} · falta 1 día} other{Fecha límite: {date} · faltan {days} días}}`, EN `{days, plural, =1{Deadline: {date} · 1 day left} other{Deadline: {date} · {days} days left}}`, CA `{days, plural, =1{Termini: {date} · falta 1 dia} other{Termini: {date} · falten {days} dies}}`), `reminderPlanNoticeTomorrowAt` (ES `{hour, plural, one{Es mañana a la {time}} other{Es mañana a las {time}}}`, EN `{hour, plural, other{It’s tomorrow at {time}}}`, CA `{hour, plural, one{És demà a la {time}} other{És demà a les {time}}}`), `reminderPlanNoticeTodayAt` (ES `{hour, plural, one{Es hoy a la {time}} other{Es hoy a las {time}}}`, EN `{hour, plural, other{It’s today at {time}}}`, CA `{hour, plural, one{És avui a la {time}} other{És avui a les {time}}}`) and `reminderPlanNoticeDeadlineTomorrow`. The Catalan beyond review D's three examples, and the deadline-tomorrow line in all three languages, are the organizer's, following the catalogs' existing forms. Replace `planNotice` with this: move the logic into ReminderCopy and delete `planNotice`, or give it what it needs. The snoozed plan rows in `reconcile` (:405-438) use the same body.

UX-2012 (S1). English only: `reminderPlanNoticeWas` (app_en.arb:3657) “It was for yesterday” → “It was planned for yesterday”, parallel to “It was due yesterday”. Spanish and Catalan stay: they are the owner's words.

UX-2009 (S2). Every task notice gets «Completar» and «Posponer 10 min» (`reminderNotificationDetails`, notification_service.dart:48-72), so «Presentar el proyecto · Faltan 12 días» offers a 10-minute snooze that brings the same countdown back, and on «Era para ayer» it turns the one last notice into two. Fix: a plan's notices (`ReminderEngine.isPlanAlert(reminder.identity)`) carry only «Completar». On iOS, register a category with only «Completar» next to `task_<lang>` (:229-231, :291-294) and use it for plan notices. Single reminders keep both actions. The engine test «a snoozed plan reminder keeps saying how far the day is» (App/test/reminder_plan_engine_test.dart:305) may keep testing a stored snooze row, with the new body.

UX-2004 (S2). A plan notice that has fired stays `elapsed` and is never cancelled (reminder_engine.dart:449-468), so a Normal plan leaves «Faltan 20 días», «Faltan 17 días», «Faltan 14 días»… stacked in the shade, each true only on its day, pushing real reminders down. Fix: one plan notice per task in the shade. In `reconcile`, when a task has more than one fired plan notice (its `elapsed` plan rows), cancel all but the newest by its fire time (`driver.cancel(id)` also removes a shown notification) and mark them inactive. Completing the task already clears them all. No copy.

UX-2010 (S2). Only the next 4 notices are set (`take(ReminderPlans.window)`, :174-191); the rest wait for the job after a notice rings, the hourly job or opening the app. In the daily stretch 4 notices cover 4 days, so a phone that defers background work never sets «Es mañana» and «Es hoy», the ones that matter. Fix: always set a plan's day-before (1), day-of (0) and last (-1) notices when they're still ahead, alongside the next four and without duplicates: at most 3 more alarms per plan, well within the 400 capacity (60 on iOS, where the capacity cut still applies). No copy.

Don't touch: when notices ring (D1, D2), the single reminders' text and actions, the morning and evening check-ins, Settings, the first reminder question. Update the planNotice tests (App/test/reminder_plans_test.dart:817-836) to the new bodies. Note for the main session: Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md, «The notifications», quotes «… · faltan 12 días» and says only the next few are scheduled; it should say the day and time, one notice per task in the shade, «Completar» only, and the last days always set.

`reminderNotificationDetails` for a plan notice before the day, on the day, and for the last notice: exactly one Android action, «Completar»; a single reminder keeps «Completar» and «Posponer 10 min».

packages.title: Outside the sheet: the Pro screen says what «A tu manera» does, and Recordatorios says when plans ring
brief: UX-2007 (S2). For a free account the Pro screen's first line is the only description of «A tu manera» (its row has no subtitle, just «Pro»), and it repeats the row's name: «Con Pro, tus recordatorios a tu manera» (App/lib/screens/subscription_screen.dart:89-99, `billingReasonReminderPlans`, app_es.arb:1402, app_ca.arb:1106, app_en.arb:3696; render reminders/sheet.pro-screen.*); TalkBack reads it merged into the card, not as a heading. Fix: say what it does, with an example, on two lines, by review D's own rule for a line that would pass 3 lines at 2× (today's shorter line already takes 3). The reason, in titleMedium as now and marked `Semantics(header: true)`: ES «Con Pro, pide los avisos con tus palabras:», EN “With Pro, ask for reminders in your own words:”, CA «Amb Pro, demana els avisos amb les teves paraules:». Under it, in the style of the card's `billingIntro` line, the example, in its quotes and with no final period: ES `«cada 3 días y la última semana a diario»`, EN `“every 3 days, and daily the last week”`, CA `«cada 3 dies i l’última setmana cada dia»` (a new key, for example `billingReasonReminderPlansExample`). The rest of the card is unchanged.

UX-2011 (S1). «Tareas sin hora» in Ajustes › Recordatorios (App/lib/screens/notification_settings_screen.dart:296-297, `_time` :186-188) now also sets the hour of every plan without its own time (`plan.time ?? dateOnlyTime ?? 540`, App/lib/services/reminder_plans.dart:40-42). Set to «Desactivado», plans still ring at 9:00, and the screen says neither (render settings/reminders.on.*). Fix: only when the row is off and some open task has a plan without its own time (`ReminderPlans.active(task)` not null, its `time` null, the task not completed, from `taskProvider`), the row's subtitle reads ES «Desactivado · «Hasta la fecha límite»: 9:00», EN `Off · “Until the deadline”: 9:00 AM`, CA «Desactivat · «Fins al termini»: 9:00», the time being `ReminderPlans.defaultMinute` in the app's clock format. A new key with a `time` placeholder, for example `dateOnlyOffPlans`: ES `Desactivado · «Hasta la fecha límite»: {time}`, EN `Off · “Until the deadline”: {time}`, CA `Desactivat · «Fins al termini»: {time}`. Review D wrote the Catalan with «data límit»; it follows UX-1909's «Fins al termini» (P245). If the owner renames the row (D4), this line follows. Otherwise the row is unchanged.

Don't touch: the Pro screen's other lines and buttons, RevenueCat's paywall (D7 is the owner's), the other Recordatorios rows. Re-render reminders/sheet.pro-screen (es 1×, 2×; ca 2×) and add `settings/reminders.all-day-off-plans` (es 1×: «Tareas sin hora» off, one open task with Normal).
acceptance: Free account, the Pro screen opened from «A tu manera · Pro», Spanish, 1×: the card's first line reads «Con Pro, pide los avisos con tus palabras:» and is a heading for TalkBack; the next reads «cada 3 días y la última semana a diario» in « »; then the existing «Dictados sin límite…».
At 2× on 360×800, Spanish and Catalan: the reason, its example and the pinned «Ver suscripción» are all on screen.

English: “With Pro, ask for reminders in your own words:” then `“every 3 days, and daily the last week”`; Catalan: «Amb Pro, demana els avisos amb les teves paraules:» then «cada 3 dies i l’última setmana cada dia» in « ».

Ajustes › Recordatorios, reminders on, «Tareas sin hora» off, one open task with Normal: the row's subtitle reads «Desactivado · «Hasta la fecha límite»: <9:00 in the app's clock>» (12-hour English `Off · “Until the deadline”: 9:00 AM`; Catalan «Desactivat · «Fins al termini»: …»); with no planned task, or only completed ones, «Desactivado» alone; with «Tareas sin hora» at 8:00, the row reads 8:00 as now.

decisions.question: A plan replaces a timed task's own reminder, so on its day it rings at 9:00, not before the time (UX-2001, S4; review A's question 1, review B's question 2 and review D's question 4 all raise it). The contract says «A plan replaces the single reminder», and every plan notice, the day's included, rings at the plan's time or Settings' all-day time (9:00). «Análisis de sangre» on Thu 12 Nov at 8:00, «Sí» to the offer: the 7:50 reminder is gone, and the day's only notice, «Es hoy», comes at 9:00, an hour after. A 17:00 presentation gets 9:00 and nothing at 16:50, while Recordatorios still promises «10 minutos antes». Options: (a) as built; (b) on the anchor's own day, a timed task (or a deadline with a time) rings at its usual reminder — its own lead, else «Tareas con hora», 10 minutes by default — with the single reminder's text («Hoy a las 17:00 · en 10 min») instead of 9:00; earlier days keep the plan's time, and the count doesn't change; (c) keep the single reminder alongside the plan.
decisions.recommendation: (b), as all three reviewers recommend: one notice on the day, at the moment it's useful, and nothing extra (TA-5, TA-12). One small package (the engine's plan rule, and that notice's text and «Posponer 10 min») and one line of the contract; reversible. Meanwhile P244 stops the offer for a task with a reminder of its own (UX-1803), so «avísame una hora antes» is kept; «Sí» on other timed tasks still moves their day's reminder to 9:00 until you answer.

decisions.question: How far back should a strength start? (UX-1912, S3; review B's question 3 and review D's question 1.) Each strength starts “from now on”, so the count grows with distance: Normal gives 13 notices at 3 weeks (your example), 24 at 8 weeks, 66 at 6 months, about 127 at a year; at 6 months Suave gives 30 and Intenso 98. The offer's one-tap «Sí» sets Normal for any task 14 or more days away. Options: (a) as built; (b) start at most 6 weeks before the day (review B): Normal at most 20, Suave 10, Intenso 29; (c) start at most 4 weeks before (review D): Normal at most 15, Suave 8, Intenso 22. Your 3-week example stays 13 in every option.
decisions.recommendation: (c), 4 weeks: the closest to your own example, so «Sí» never means more than about 15 notices, and Intenso stays clearly stronger (NO-5: people already get a median of 56 notifications a day; TA-12: a few well-placed reminders already help). The sheet's words and dots show the later start by themselves («Cada 3 días desde 4 semanas antes, y a diario la última semana»). Three numbers in `ReminderPlan.strengthPhases` and the contract's table; reversible.

decisions.question: A reminder said for a task with no day is dropped without a word (UX-1812, S2; review A's question 2). With no day or deadline the server sets no plan (contract, «The dictation»), «una hora antes» on a task with no time is dropped (App/lib/models/capture_session.dart:88-90), and a repeating task gets no plan. So «Llamar a mamá, recuérdamelo cada día» saves with no reminder, and nothing on the card says so. Options: (a) the server flags a reminder it heard but couldn't keep, and the card shows one line under the date, which opens the date sheet: «Para recordártelo, ponle un día.» / “To remind you, give it a day.” / «Per recordar-t’ho, posa-li un dia.» (the Catalan is the organizer's); (b) leave it until the §7 test.
decisions.recommendation: (a): the assistant heard «recuérdamelo», and the card should say what it needs instead of dropping it (VO-5: show what was understood). It adds one field on the server (the main session's work) and one line on the card (a small app package); reversible.

decisions.question: «Hasta la fecha límite» on tasks that only have a day (UX-1911, S2; review B's question 1, also noted by reviews A and D). It's your name for the row. Most tasks only have a day, and everywhere else «Fecha límite» names a separate field (the detail's «Fecha límite» row, «Quitar fecha límite», «Fecha límite: …» in notifications), so on a day-only task the row names something the task doesn't have; its subtitle, «Cada vez más a menudo hasta el jue 12», is what says what it does. Options: (a) keep it; (b) make the subtitle the title: «Cada vez más a menudo», with «hasta el jue 12» under it, for a deadline and a day alike (CA «Cada cop més sovint» / «fins al dj. 12», EN “More and more often” / “until Thu 12”), and the messages that name the row say «Cada vez más a menudo»; (c) keep «Hasta la fecha límite» on tasks with a deadline and say «Hasta el día» on the others.
decisions.recommendation: (b): it says what the choice does, in words a newcomer reads the same on any task (SC-1, SC-9), with no new concept. A strings package (the row, its two messages, and Recordatorios' line from P247); reversible. Until you answer, P245 makes the Catalan say «Fins al termini», the word the rest of the Catalan app uses for a deadline.

decisions.question: Should the offer stop for someone who keeps saying «Ahora no»? (UX-2013, S2; review D's question 2.) Every far task saved brings it, once per task, with no way to say “stop asking”.
decisions.recommendation: After two «Ahora no» in a row on this phone, stop offering; «Hasta la fecha límite» stays in every task's reminder sheet (NO-5; SU-6's “no repeated nagging”, by analogy). A small change in the offer; reversible.

decisions.question: Plans on shared tasks (UX-2014, S2; review D's question 3). A plan is a synced task field: set on a «Todos» task it rings on every member's phone (about 13 notices each, with nothing saying who set them); set on Ana's task it rings on Ana's. P244 already keeps the offer to tasks that ring on this phone alone (UX-2003); this is about the reminder sheet. Options: (a) as built; (b) plans only on tasks that ring on this phone alone (personal, or assigned to you): the sheet doesn't show the plan rows on «Todos» tasks or on other people's.
decisions.recommendation: (b) (SH-4: don't notify other people without their say). A small sheet change; reversible. If plans for the whole project are wanted later, they need a line saying who set them.

decisions.question: RevenueCat's paywall («Ver suscripción») lists Pro's benefits from its dashboard, which doesn't mention «A tu manera» (UX-2015, S1; review D's question 5), so the paywall says less than the screen before it.
decisions.recommendation: Add «A tu manera» to the paywall's Pro benefits in the RevenueCat dashboard, in P247's words («Pide los avisos con tus palabras»). It's your task: agents don't touch external services.
